policies.title: Identity
policies.definition: The output is the input, code point for code point. Input bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are rejected.

policies.title: Unicode Normalization Form C
policies.definition: UAX #15 canonical decomposition, canonical ordering and canonical composition. Lone surrogates and noncharacters pass through unchanged. Input bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are rejected.

policies.title: Unicode Normalization Form KC
policies.definition: UAX #15 compatibility decomposition, canonical ordering and canonical composition. Lone surrogates and noncharacters pass through unchanged. Input bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are rejected.

policies.title: Raw-safe cleaning without letter changes, version 1
policies.definition: NFC plus removal of invalid code points and invisible controls (a meaningful ZWNJ or emoji ZWJ is kept). No letter, mark, digit or punctuation is changed. Recipe for text_diac columns and for display or legal uses.

policies.title: Bayanat Labs standard Arabic text normalisation, version 1
policies.definition: A normalisation policy for text_norm columns. NFC plus mapping of Arabic presentation forms; invisible controls removed except a meaningful ZWNJ or emoji ZWJ; tatweel, harakat, Quranic marks and superscript alef removed; alef variants to bare alef; alef maqsura to yeh; taa marbuta kept and flagged; Arabic-Indic and Extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII; honorific ligatures kept and flagged.

policies.title: Arabic normalisation for speech-recognition evaluation, version 1
policies.definition: bayanat-norm-v1 plus taa marbuta folded to heh, punctuation replaced by spaces and whitespace collapsed. Intended for WER and CER scoring. Lossy: use only for scoring, never as a stored text field.
